cover_headline: Nvidia, AMD and Micron Lead Chip Rebound After Worst Selloff Since 2020
facts: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12.25% on November 5, its biggest one-day drop since March 2020
AMD closed up 11% on Friday, Intel rose 8% and Micron gained 5%
The index closed 38.4% below its June 22 record close of 14,634.72

quote.text: I think that the selloff was just too steep.
quote.speaker: Jack Gold

end.headline: Nvidia, AMD and Micron Lead Chip Rebound After Worst Selloff Since 2020
end.line: Friday's rebound recovered only part of Thursday's losses, and analysts called it a reflex bounce rather than a resolution.
